title: A New badge on documents uploaded in the last 24 hours
objective: On the library list, put a small "New" badge (an element with data-testid="badge-new" reading New) next to the title of any document uploaded less than 24 hours before the store's clock (store.now()).
acceptance: The Pricing Sheet (d2, uploaded 4 hours ago) shows a New badge beside its title
The Q3 Board Deck (d1, 27 hours ago) and older documents show none
A document uploaded exactly 24 hours ago shows none; 23 hours 59 minutes ago shows one
The badge follows the store clock, not the system clock
plan_summary: Compare uploadedAt with store.now() in libraryPage; render a span beside the title.
